title: Trainee Software Engineer at GlobalLogic
content: Aman has been a Trainee Software Engineer at GlobalLogic India Private Limited, a Hitachi Group company, in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, since January 2026. This is his current role and is focused on AI/ML-oriented software engineering.

title: GlobalLogic responsibilities
content: At GlobalLogic, Aman performs data cleaning, transformation, and exploratory data analysis using Python; builds, trains, and evaluates machine-learning models with scikit-learn and appropriate evaluation metrics; applies NLP and Transformer-based techniques to text-classification and language-focused use cases; and develops Generative AI and LLM workflows involving prompt engineering, embeddings, semantic retrieval, and RAG.

title: GlobalLogic technologies and focus
content: Aman's GlobalLogic role includes Python, Data Science, Machine Learning, scikit-learn, NLP, Transformers, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, and Git. The role follows structured training in Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models.
